projects.name: Northern Virginia land acquisition (16 acres)
projects.quote: During the fourth quarter, Digital Realty made a strategic investment in AtlasEdge Data Centres, a European edge data center provider; acquired 16 acres of land in Northern Virginia for approximately $23 million; and sold a mixed-use retail and data center property in San Jose, California for approximately $60 million.

projects.name: Medallion Lagos, Nigeria land parcels
projects.quote: During the fourth quarter, Medallion, a leading Nigerian colocation and interconnection provider jointly owned by Digital Realty and Pembani Remgro, acquired two land parcels in Lagos, Nigeria.

projects.name: Teraco acquisition
projects.quote: Subsequent to quarter-end, Digital Realty announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire roughly a 55% stake in Teraco, Africa’s leading carrier-neutral colocation provider, from a consortium of investors including Berkshire Partners and Permira, in a transaction valuing Teraco at approximately $3.5 billion and representing a cap rate of approximately 3.5% on projected 2022 cash net operating income of approximately $121 million.
